notes: No bot wall on search or detail pages. Search results give title/price/location/URL; detail pages add photos + full description. Best primary automated source - check your metro area's relevant listing categories.

Automated unauthenticated fetch returns only a login splash-screen shell - confirmed blocked. Workaround: while logged into Facebook in a real browser, view-source or copy the page HTML of a Marketplace search-results page and paste it in directly - that HTML contains structured listing data (title/price/location/listing-id/image) that parses easily, surfacing dozens of listings from one paste. Photo URLs are FB CDN links with signed/expiring tokens and may stop loading after a while.

Search results return HTTP 403 on every attempt, with and without browser-like headers. Hard bot-detection block (likely PerimeterX/Akamai), not a solvable captcha - not worth fighting. Manual-only, or would require the official Browse API with a registered developer app.

Standard Shopify storefront - /collections/<category>/products.json returns full structured data (title, price, compare-at price, tags, images) with zero JS needed. Best-structured source found. Note: certified pre-owned inventory, not peer-to-peer - prices reflect that.
Loads fine with prices visible in raw HTML, technically scrapable - but it's a new-item retail price-comparison site, not a secondhand marketplace. Low practical value vs. peer-to-peer sources.

Site-wide active Cloudflare JS challenge on every path including /robots.txt - requires executing JS and solving a browser-behavior check, not just a missing header. Not attempting to bypass. Manual-only: check the site yourself.
